heroHeadline: Storm-Sequence Toll Holds at 44 as Evacuees Ease to 46,400; Visayas Grid Hits 4-Hour Red Alert
heroSubtitle: The M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet-Pilandok storm sequence have killed 173+ across the cascade; NDRRMC's Sept 10 report holds the August-September storm toll at 44 dead, 18 injured and 5 missing as the affected population reached 10.44 million, while DSWD's Sept 13 update shows evacuation-center numbers easing to 46,424 people in 570 centers. The Visayas grid was placed under a 4-hour red alert on Sept 13 after Therma Visayas' coal units and Panay Energy Development Corp's Unit 3 went offline, with Mindanao on yellow alert both Sept 12 and 13 amid persistent forced power-plant outages; DOE still targets a stabilized Visayas grid by October via new power barges and battery storage.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
